script.hook: Meta, down two and a half percent - and a four hundred twenty billion dollar rumor is doing the rounds.
script.meter: Gentle upside - that's four on our five-point scale - and we expect it to play out inside two to three weeks.
script.story: Here's the story. The rumor says Meta is hiding four hundred twenty billion in AI debts. Meta's own filings answer it: thirty-two billion of cash came in last quarter - it covered all nineteen billion of AI spending, with thirteen billion to spare. And the filed debt? Fifty-nine billion. Not four-twenty.
script.vote: Three of our five analysts back the read. Two are not convinced - the proof is last quarter's filing, and they want the July twenty-ninth earnings before they trust it.
script.close: The full analysis is free at aftermarketmovers dot com.
